status: Provisional implementation content for the anatomical Generate prototype; not an executable catalogue until adapted and resolved, and not canonical anatomy.

coordinates.unit: arbitrary source length; no physical scale claim

copyScheme.inheritance: one exact copy from each compatible same-package parent per locus; retain donor provenance
copyScheme.assortment: independent for this prototype; no linkage model

genomeRecord.loci: Expand every new and imported locus into { locusId, recordVersion, copies: [firstAlleleId, secondAlleleId] }; include all 34 pairs, never only example overrides.
genomeRecord.baselineReferences: Carry every declared inherited baseline reference with its exact version.
genomeRecord.construction: Retain the separate anatomical-source/1 construction and anatomical-surface-fields/1 material profile in the evaluated result and strict replay recipe, not as inherited copies.

operators.copy-mean: Arithmetic mean of the two declared numeric allele values, before any geometry is constructed.
operators.dominant-enable: on/on and off/on resolve true; off/off resolves false. Ordered inherited copies remain intact.
operators.pair-map: Read the explicitly listed unordered pair key; no fallback or inferred dominance.
operators.partition-map: Reuse the exact imported pigment record and pair map; unlike copies produce two local pigment fields, not a blended colour.

inheritedBaseline.inheritance: These fixed module references are carried by every candidate in this package and inherited unchanged between compatible parents. They are new declared baseline content, not contributions inferred from the old fifty loci.
inheritedBaseline.scope: This is one bilateral, face-bearing anatomical subset. It neither replaces broader genomic structure families nor asserts that every critter needs a head or terrestrial supports.

importedLoci.meaning: Pigment of modular non-body surfaces, not a literal underside or face patch.

locusDefaults.numericUnits: source length or explicitly named local ratio
locusDefaults.researchKnowledge: separate from the complete candidate; unknown does not remove a copy

loci.meaning: Exterior ocular module presence only; visual performance is unmodeled.
Static vertical chain span; not stride, force or a physical bone-length claim.
Body material field on declared head/core/posterior owners; not a scale object added to the anatomy.

loci.units: fraction of each applicable owner local longitudinal u; begins at u=.20
fraction of applicable owner longitudinal length; no physical scale thickness

surfaceOwnership.coverage: Smooth skin is the complete base surface. Scale expression overlays an owned material field on head/core/present posterior in local u=.20 through .20+extent, excluding ocular mounts. Other body modules/supports/terminals/crowns remain smooth; wings remain smooth thin surfaces. No anatomical scale objects or fur/feathers/markings/emission are installed.
surfaceOwnership.localFields: Every region has local longitudinal u from its negative-X to positive-X bound. Neck/support u runs from proximal root to distal end; terminal u runs negative-X to positive-X. Crown u runs base to tip. Wing u runs root to outer edge. Uniform palette fills the entire owner; a two-entry palette uses equal low/high-u fields in the exact imported array order. Record both the atlas and masks; no whole-creature split, blending, cream muzzle or underside invention.

coveringConstruction.ownerDomain: head, core and present posterior local ellipsoid surface
coveringConstruction.atlasV: six circumferential bands around each owner longitudinal X axis
coveringConstruction.scaleRows: ceil(extent / resolved local scale length), last longitudinal row clipped to exact field end
coveringConstruction.realization: Retained ellipsoid-surface patches follow each owner and preserve underlying pigment masks. The finite pattern communicates scaled material; it has no tissue depth or separate anatomical object meaning.
coveringConstruction.exclusions: Clip the material field against actual ocular mounts; do not cover fixed eye inks or move them. Inactive posterior owns no field. Smooth skin retains extent/size copies and marks their field contribution inactive.

founderSupport.meaning: Allowed independent choices for the provisional Generate operation, not a species distribution or a sample entitlement.
founderSupport.choices: Every declared allele at every locus plus every exact imported pigment allele; draw ordered copies independently under a pinned existing seeded sampler. No morphology quotas, animal class selector or repair.
founderSupport.acceptance: Keep the first eligible complete draw within the existing total 1024-attempt ceiling; retain actual winning seed/attempt, all ordered copies and source traces. An exhausted search returns its actual failure summary.

workedInputs.meaning: Authored complete-copy inputs after default expansion; these are not evaluated genomes, actual source identities or presets used by Generate.

examples.label: Compact / stocky
examples.expectedOrganization: Broad head and trunk, short muzzle, four stocky rooted chains, broad terminal volumes and rounded crown surfaces.

examples.label: Lean / projecting
examples.expectedOrganization: Same role graph with a lean trunk, smaller head, projecting muzzle, longer slender four supports, narrower terminals and pointed crown surfaces.

examples.label: Three regions / six supports / paired wings
examples.expectedOrganization: Small head, support-bearing middle core and extended posterior; three support pairs rooted on the core, plus one paired dorsal wing surface. This tests insect-like organization, not species identity, flight or firefly emission.

mixedCopyTrace.meaning: A new intermediate terminal shape under the same operator, without selecting a parent body preset.

conditionalTrace.whenOff: Carried and resolved, but inactive for construction because anatomy.wing-presence off/off has no wing owner.
conditionalTrace.whenOn: The same copies scale both inherited wing surfaces; no automatic third support pair or posterior is installed.

exclusions: old fifty loci silently relabeled as organs
toes, claw, paw-pad or hoof-cleft anatomy
mouth opening or feeding capability inferred from jaw geometry
fur, shell or anatomical scale tissue detail
canonical allele frequencies or palette approval
